{{Quote|In the Guild, oddballs are the norm, not the exception. ''[&hellip;]'' Take ''[&hellip;]'' Count Dojarat of Prospera Jang, the gentleman adventurer who lets his marks go free if they beat him at boxing.|Arack Dostryt, the ''Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook''|<ref name="BHC" />}}
'''Prospera Jang''' was a celestial body<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> located in the [[Prospera Jang system/Legends|Prospera Jang system]], a part of the [[Kurost sector/Legends|Kurost sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[34 BBY/Legends|34 BBY]], [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] forces under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of the [[Harch/Legends|Harch]] military leader [[Trench/Legends|Trench]] captured the [[Kurosti merchant fleet]] during a daring [[Raid at Prospera Jang|raid]] at Prospera Jang.<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dojarat]] [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed]] from Prospera Jang, a fact that was noted by [[Arack Dostryt]], the [[Director of Recruiting]] for the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]], in a section of an edition of the ''[[Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook]]'' published<ref name="BHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref> at some point between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'' includes an [[in-universe]] copy of the ''[[Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook]]''. The included edition of the Handbook was published at some point following the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and is annotated by [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]], whose [[Death/Legends|death]] is depicted in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the formation of the Empire and the events of ''A New Hope'' in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], respectively, the included edition of the Bounty Hunters' Guild Handbook must have therefore been published at some point between those two dates.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Prospera Jang was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' later placed the Prospera Jang [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Prospera Jang, in grid square Q-11.<ref name="EAOC" />
